create_fake_dataset: create a fake ASE database from a FakeDatasetConfig with random atomic structures and LJ energies
generate_structures: generate fake atomic structures with Lennard-Jones energies and repulsive pairwise forces from a config
create_fake_benchmark_dataset: create all five UMA benchmark datasets with production-like system sizes in a temp directory
compute_energy_lj: compute the Lennard-Jones potential energy for an ASE Atoms object given epsilon and sigma parameters
calculate_forces_repulsive: calculate repulsive pairwise forces between atoms in an ASE Atoms object using inverse distance squared scaling
